title: Avidbank Holdings, Inc. Announces Completion of $30 Million Subordinated Debt Offering
summary: SAN JOSE, CA / ACCESS Newswire / August 26, 2026 / (NASDAQ:AVBH) (or the "Company"), the holding company for Avidbank (the "Bank"), today announced the closing of a $30 million private placement of fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes. The Company plans to use the net proceeds to repurchase and/or redeem its outstanding $22 million of callable subordinated notes and for general corporate purposes.
